title: SourceDialog
responsibility: Shows a read-only source reader in the shared modal without changing the current address.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.open
inputs.description: Whether to show and mount the reader.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.title
inputs.description: Entity or callable name used in the dialog title.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.files
inputs.description: Lists owned files for this source session.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.read
inputs.description: Reads the captured revision of a selected file.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.commit
inputs.description: Source revision shown beside the selector.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.onClose
inputs.description: Host closes the session and restores focus.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.empty
inputs.description: Optional message for histories without archived source.

outputs.name: SourceDialog
outputs.description: Open dialogs mount the source reader. Closed dialogs read nothing. Escape and close delegate to the host, which restores initiating focus.
